name: Radar Jammer - Crit
RelatedDescription: A miniaturized ST positioner that allows ally STs to gain positions and guide missiles to accurately hit targets within range. Also integrates a function that affects the enemy's Crit capability.

61198.name: TacW Guidance II · Crit
61198.SpecificEffects:
Enables the ST's adjacent (<color=#F74848>2</color> tiles) area to become a valid attack zone for allies' Missile and Rocket attacks.
In combat, the enemy's Crit Rate <color=#F74848>-10%</color>.
ST Body's HP <color=#F74848>+10%</color>, DMG Dealt <color=#F74848>+5%</color>.
